name: B10-0420/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It sets out its position and asks the European Union and its member states to do more for people in Afghanistan after the August 2025 earthquakes. It calls for more emergency aid, especially for women and girls, and for women to be allowed to take part in delivering it. It also asks member states to stop sending Afghans back and to speed up visas for those at risk.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a request for more aid, visas and no deportations.
- **Who it affects:** People hit by the earthquakes, Afghan women and girls, and Afghans seeking asylum in the EU.
- **What happens next:** EU institutions and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
